📝 Assignment Question Format
For multiple-choice questions, enter the question, four options and the correct answer: 
1. Which organ pumps blood around the human body?
A. Lungs B. HeartC. Kidney D. Stomach
Answer: B
===
2. Which gas do green plants mainly use during photosynthesis?
   A. Oxygen B. Nitrogen C. Carbon dioxide D. Hydrogen
Answer: C
Use === between questions. Written questions can also be included without A-D options.

📦 INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
School stock, procurement, distribution and fixed-asset control
Legacy inventory records remain available from the original inventory/{schoolId} store. New structured records use school-scoped inventory paths and do not trigger an automatic destructive migration. Confirmed quantity changes are transaction-controlled; final authorization still depends on your Firebase Security Rules.

Inventory Dashboard

Live counts and recent activity. Financial valuation reflects recorded unit costs multiplied by usable and damaged stock where a balance is available.

Recent Stock Movements

Items Requiring Attention

Inventory Categories

Add school-specific categories; categories referenced by historical items are retained.

Items and Stock Management

Register items, set stock thresholds, review balances, and inspect transaction history. Existing legacy stock is displayed without being moved.
Stock balances are changed by posted receipts, issues, transfers, returns, or approved adjustments—not by directly editing the balance field.

Stock Receipts

Only confirmed, usable receipts increase available stock. Rejected or damaged delivery quantities are recorded separately.

Stock Issues and Distribution

Stock is deducted only when an issue is confirmed. Learners can be selected from the school’s existing learner records.

Purchase Requests and Approvals

A purchase approval is not a stock receipt or supplier payment. Approved requests may be used to create purchase orders.

Suppliers Management

Maintain genuine supplier records and review linked purchase history.

Purchase Orders and Deliveries

Create orders only from approved requests. Actual inventory increases only through confirmed stock receipts.

Stock Transfers

Dispatch moves stock from available at the source into in-transit. Destination stock increases only after receipt confirmation.

Returns, Damaged and Lost Items

Returned stock is not usable until inspected. Lost stock is not restored to available quantities.

Fixed Assets Management

Individually track durable property by unique tag. Fixed assets are separate from consumable stock balances.

Stocktaking and Reconciliation

Enter physical counts, review variances, and approve an adjustment only if the balance has not changed since it was counted.

Reorder and Low Stock Alerts

Recommendations consider current usable quantities and confirmed in-transit quantities where available. They do not automatically create purchase requests.

Inventory Assignments

Track consumable distribution and reusable equipment custody. Reusable stock is deducted when issued and restored only after a usable return is confirmed.

Inventory Reports

Reports are assembled from saved records retrieved from this school’s inventory paths. Restricted views should be protected by Firebase rules as well as UI permissions.
Choose a report and select Generate report.

Inventory Settings

School-specific defaults. These settings do not change historical costs or existing stock balances.
FIFO remains an option label only; do not use it until cost layers are implemented and verified.

💻 ICT MANAGEMENT

School technology assets, support, laboratory operations, maintenance, licensing and security records.
Existing pooled equipment and borrowing history remain in the legacy ict/{schoolId} store and remain readable below. New structured ICT records are stored under schools/{schoolId}/. ICT consumables are shown from the existing Inventory records rather than being stocked a second time. Access restrictions in this screen must be backed by Firebase Security Rules.
ICT Dashboard
Filters apply to the current register where the record contains the selected field.

Upcoming laboratory use

Upcoming sessions are based on saved ICT laboratory timetable records.

Recent ICT activity

Recent auditable changes recorded by this module.

ICT Asset Register

Individual durable assets, manually entered specifications, lifecycle and valuation.

Legacy pooled devices

Existing records from ict/{schoolId} remain intact, with their original borrow/return history.

Computer and Device Management

Computer specifications, operating system, installed software summary, location and inspection history.

ICT Laboratories

Lab workstations, responsible staff, opening hours, status, safety instructions and unresolved facility issues.

Equipment Allocation and Returns

Controlled issue/return of unique assets. Missing assets are not cleared by ordinary return actions.

ICT Helpdesk and Technical Support

Track priorities, ownership, troubleshooting, resolution times and escalation history.

Repairs and Maintenance

Preventive schedules, corrective work, parts, service providers, costs, downtime and warranty coverage.

Software and License Management

License capacity and renewal alerts. Do not enter secret license keys; store only a non-secret reference.

Network and Internet Management

Network equipment and documented outages. This register does not discover devices or perform live monitoring.

Network incidents and outages

ICT Inventory and Consumables

Read-only ICT-related item view sourced from the existing Inventory module. Stock receipts, issues and balances remain managed by Inventory.

ICT Procurement and Replacements

Request and approve purchases or replacements without creating stock or issuing payments.

Warranty and Service Contracts

Coverage, support contacts, expiry and renewals. Warranty history is preserved as individual records.

ICT Security and Incident Register

Restricted log for suspected unauthorized access, phishing, malware alerts, lost devices and data exposure.
Do not store passwords, tokens, private keys or exploit instructions. Access restrictions must also be enforced by Firebase Security Rules or a trusted backend.

Laboratory Sessions and Usage

Lab timetabling with overlap checks, responsible teacher, class, workstations and after-session faults.

ICT Staff and Technician Management

References existing school staff/users by name or ID; this does not create duplicate user accounts.

ICT Reports

Records are queried from the selected school. Export the generated result to CSV or print an A4 report.
Select a report and choose Generate report.

ICT Settings

School-specific defaults for numbering, reminder periods, categories, approvals and laboratory opening hours.

ICT Record
